name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 10 – Am 61
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 10a. Recalls that freedom of religion or belief includes the freedom to change one’s religion or belief or to have none, as recognised in Article 10 of the Charter and Article 18 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights; calls on the Commission and the Member States to ensure that individuals in the EU are fully protected from intimidation, violence or coercion linked to the exercise of this freedom;
